findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:2,3,4,5 evidence command mismatch: intents require grep for pinned numbers 151 / 70280 / 258 / 49, but all four evidence entries record command='grep -c ^## ', note='6 H2 sections'. The command field does not concretely correspond to the intent — violates B-d7ef bind-to-literal-command lesson. Reviewer independently verified all four numbers are present in the doc.

CHK-001:happy:9 evidence command mismatch: intent is 'grep each of B1 B2 B3 B4 in doc -> all four follow-up story IDs present', but recorded command='grep -c ^## ', note='6 H2 sections'. B1-B4 presence check is a distinct intent from section count. CHK-001:adversarial:0 also mismatched: intent is 'git diff main -- testing-infra.md | wc -l returns 0 (byte-identical guard)', but recorded command='grep -c testing-infra' (reference count check). Reviewer independently verified B1-B4 present and testing-infra.md diff=0.
